steps.description: Read state, constraints, assumptions, decisions, prompt contract, and prior lane task context
Map current transport, session, retry, timeout, rate limiter, circuit breaker, auth, streaming, and telemetry code paths
Validate or reject architecture claims with file and line evidence
Define the current mental model and compare it to an optimal transport-layer model
Evaluate no-change, minimal-change, and medium-change recommendations with benefits, risks, and breaking-change impact
Write complete architecture analysis and recommendations inside the task directory
Verify documentation completeness, evidence coverage, and internal consistency
